messages:
Maya: Muni 22 is crawling past Hayes, everyone look like soggy ducks. 20m delay at least. umbrella? hoodie? splash pants? :umbrella: :sweat_drops:
Jon: same, saw an alert on 511: 'bus slow due to standing water near Market & 8th' link <https://511.org/alerts/12345>
Liam: umbrella + waterproof shoes. also pro tip: bring a garbage bag for the seat on the bus :grimacing:
Emily: Hoodie person here, but my shoes are drenched. Anyone bringing spare flip-flops to the office? :raised_hand:
Raj: I'll toss a pair of extra sneakers in the office bench. Drop by 3rd floor. :thumbsup:
Jen: lol office shoe swap, love it. ETA impacted? I'm running late to the 10am standup.
Maya: can we push 10 to 10:10? bus ETA unknown. @everyone
Priya: I'm remote today, but vote: umbrella > hoodie > garbage bag. :v:
transit-bot: Automated alert: MUNI 22 experiencing 15-25 minute delays due to flooding at Market St. Alternate: take 19 or walk to 16th St. See: http://muni.status/alert-987
Jon: fwiw 19 is packed, 16th walk was flooded too earlier. 
Liam: new plan—if you're downtown, meet at cafe on 2nd & F at 10:05, else join remote. I'll bring an extra towel. 
Emily: thanks Liam, appreciate the towel offer. also @Raj you're a hero. :pray:
Jen: can someone gif this into #random for morale? 'corporate soggy duck' opener.
Maya: posting later. tiny poll: who needs a ride from Hayes to office? reply with 'ride' if yes.
Jon: ride
Raj: can take 1 person after standup, DM me
Maya: ok collected. see y'all soon (probably soggy). :boot:
